title: Japan's Omron to buy US industrial PC firm Onlogic for $675 million in physical AI push
description: TOKYO, Oct 13 (Reuters) - Japanese manufacturer Omron will buy US industrial PC firm Onlogic and its parent company, Interlogic, for $675 million, the company said on Tuesday.

title: AI council launches finance certification in Singapore
description: Rising AI use is exposing a training gap in Singapore's finance sector, prompting a new exam to test when professionals should trust or verify output.
